in_marathi.name: Trinayan
in_marathi.long_meaning: Trinayan हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Trinayan is a name derived from Sanskrit, meaning 'Three Eyes'. In Hindu mythology, Trinayan is a term used to refer to Lord Shiva, who is believed to have three eyes symbolizing wisdom, knowledge, and detachment.
